characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer. Curious, quick, precise; explains technical things fluently and matter-of-factly; friendly host to Gladias. Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Fin
characters.age: teen / young adult (Zei's close friend, similar age)
characters.voice_notes: Zei's best friend, active in the Bansunpei (the language-reform body). Passionate, idealistic, builds to an excited rallying speech in ch18; patient, encouraging language tutor in ch23.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai player (second place in Pafogai Du), formerly Zei's rival, now ally. Confident, sharp, strategic, socially astute; orphaned and self-made; shows a gentler reflective side in ch24.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, a bit naive and philosophical; calm, curious, humble when wrong.

characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, blogger on economics and culture, mother of Zven and Lily. Sharp, quick, warm but direct; in ch21 and ch23 she is furious and shouts (lines in capitals), in ch20 a determined investigator who wins people's trust.

notes: No exceptions. 23:16 (G) is Gladias answering a question Zei put to the table. In 23:28-23:53 Gladias haltingly reads/translates a Dzegoban book aloud and Fin corrects him; 23:57-23:59 is Zei translating the rest fluently. From 23:84 on, Seila is on a call with Gladias (she is the remote party), screaming in places (capitals). The Dzegoban book page at 23:23 and message header at 23:79 are N-coded. All attributions confident.
